description: JHYY (机会翼游) — statically-typed language + bootstrapping compiler for Windows
notes: This installer is per-machine: it writes to C:\Program Files\JHYY and to the HKLM PATH.
Scoop is per-user by default — run `scoop install jhyy --global` from an elevated shell, or accept the UAC prompt during install.

v4.1.0+: MSYS2 is NO LONGER required — the installer ships a minimal native ucrt64 toolchain (gcc + binutils + CRT + headers) under C:\Program Files\JHYY\toolchain\, so `jhyy compile hello.jhyy` works on a bare Windows machine. To use your own gcc instead, set JHY_GCC=<full path to gcc.exe> or put 'JHY_GCC=<full path>' into %JHYY_HOME%\env.txt.
After install, `where jhyy` should list it under Program Files.
The installer is unsigned — Windows SmartScreen will show an 'Unknown publisher' warning.

script: # Burn bundle uninstall — the MSI underneath it (per-machine ⇒ needs elevation).
# That GUID is the MSI's UpgradeCode (stable across releases), not the per-build
# ProductCode — msiexec /x resolves it to whichever product is currently installed.
# See installer/GUIDS.md. Or: Settings -> Apps -> JHYY Compiler -> Uninstall.
